dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge exhibiting a falcate curvature measured from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius, exhibiting an obtuse transition toward the trailing edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steeply inclined anterior margin oriented at approximately 50 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible horizontal base width is approximately 1.4 times the maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible light-colored linear rake marks on the lateral surface; minor indentations and nicks present along the mid-to-lower trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced darkened pigmentation gradient at the posterior junction of the fin base and the dorsal ridge.
